theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_transEst_volume_symmDiff_eq_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A F : Set (Rn N)) (R : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet A volume → NullMeasurableSet F volume → volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff A F) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R, |A.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) y - F.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) y|)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
